verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI that generates insights or suggestions from a user's data inside Anytype. What it documents is an MCP server, a local API and an agents skill that let external AI assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) read and modify Anytype data. Those are building blocks for outside tools, not an in-product AI feature. Queries, Graph and Widgets are deterministic organizing features, not AI-generated insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
